description: This file defines React components and interfaces related to search filters in a career navigation app. It includes UI components for selecting job titles, industries, skills, and salary ranges, as well as managing and displaying active filter tags.

classes.name: FiltersProps
classes.description: Props interface for the Filters component, including selected filters, options, and callback functions.

classes.name: ActiveFilterTagsProps
classes.description: Props interface for the ActiveFilterTags component, managing current filters and change handlers.

methods.name: FieldLabel
methods.description: A simple component rendering a label with muted text styling.

methods.name: FieldShell
methods.description: A container component for form fields, arranging children vertically with spacing.

methods.name: LoadingField
methods.description: Emulates a loading placeholder for a form field.

methods.name: InlineError
methods.description: Displays an inline error message with styled background and border.

methods.name: StructuredSelect
methods.description: A dropdown select component with options fetched from backend, supporting sorting and 'All' selection.

methods.name: MultiSelectSkills
methods.description: A multi-select dropdown for skills, with search, selection chips, and tags.

methods.name: Filters
methods.description: Main filter UI component for selecting job title, industry, skills, and salary, with loading and error states.

methods.name: ActiveFilterTags
methods.description: Component for displaying active filters as removable chips with a 'Clear All' option.
